rules.description: Company name must not be the same as an existing registered company
rules.reason_if_failed: This company name is already registered or too similar to an existing name. You must choose a different name.

rules.description: All directors must be at least 16 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: Directors must be at least 16 years old to register a company

rules.description: Directors must not be disqualified from acting as a director
rules.reason_if_failed: You are disqualified from acting as a company director. Contact Companies House for advice.

rules.description: Company must have at least one director
rules.reason_if_failed: You must appoint at least one director to register a company

rules.description: Registered office address must be a physical UK address
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide a physical UK address (not a PO Box) as your registered office address

rules.description: Registered office must be in same country as company registration
rules.reason_if_failed: A company registered in England must have a registered office in England. Choose the correct registration jurisdiction or update your address.

rules.description: Company limited by shares must have at least one shareholder, or limited by guarantee must have at least one guarantor
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have at least one shareholder (for limited by shares) or guarantor (for limited by guarantee)

rules.description: Company must have articles of association (model or custom)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide articles of association. You can use standard model articles or upload custom articles.

edge_cases.description: Company name is too similar to existing name or trademark
edge_cases.action: You may be asked to change your company name if someone complains it's too similar to their registered name or trademark. Choose a more distinctive name to avoid this risk.

edge_cases.description: Company name contains sensitive words requiring permission
edge_cases.action: Your company name contains words like 'Accredited', 'Royal', or others requiring permission. You must get approval from the relevant authority before registration.
CICs have different requirements and cannot use standard model articles. You must use CIC regulator's model constitutions and meet additional criteria.

edge_cases.description: Company secretary cannot be the auditor or an undischarged bankrupt
edge_cases.action: Your company secretary cannot be the company's auditor or an undischarged bankrupt (unless they have court permission). Choose a different person.

edge_cases.description: Using accountant or solicitor address as registered office
edge_cases.action: If using a service provider's address, you must get their written permission and ensure they meet the requirements for receiving and confirming delivery of company mail.
